Nirvana's studio albums: Bleach (1989), Nevermind (1991), In Utero (1993), Unplugged (live, 1994). Best selling is Nevermind. Second most selling studio album — In Utero (released September 21, 1993). Actually Bleach sold ~3 million... wait. Nevermind ~30M. In Utero ~15M (or 5M in US, ~18M worldwide). Bleach ~3M US? Bleach certified platinum (1M US)... Actually In Utero is 5x platinum US. So second most selling is In Utero, released September 21, 1993.
